card.name: Linking words before numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "including" or "change" that sit right before a number, mainly in temperature ranges (20°C to 25°C) and web-page menu text.

modes.label: Temperature range
modes.description: The word "to" between two storage temperatures in degrees Celsius.
modes.example: Store the reconstituted suspension at 20°C<< to>> 25°C (68°F

modes.label: Pharmacy menu line
modes.description: "including" (or the space after it) before "24 hour" in the RxList pharmacy-finder line.
modes.example: Find a Local Pharmacy -<< including>> 24 hour, pharmacies

modes.label: Decimal or verb before object
modes.description: The decimal point inside a strength such as 62.5 mg, or the verb "change" before "your pad".
modes.example: Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium 250 mg/62<<.>>5 mg per 5 mL for oral

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are Chinese and science words, and the promoted ones are household and laundry words, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a number or a thing, such as the "to" in a temperature range.
